# CSS2Image

> Free browser tool that converts CSS gradient code into downloadable PNG or JPG images.

CSS2Image is not a CSS gradient generator. Most tools (color pickers / gradient makers) only help you create CSS and copy it. This site does the reverse for export: paste existing `linear-gradient`, `radial-gradient`, or `conic-gradient` CSS, choose resolution (up to 8K), and download a real image file — entirely client-side, no signup, no server upload.

## Primary use cases

- CSS to image / CSS to image download
- Export a CSS gradient background as PNG or JPG
- Create wallpaper or social-sized gradient assets from CSS you already have

## Site

- Home: https://css2img.burakkutlu.com/
- Canonical: https://css2img.burakkutlu.com/

## Features

- Paste CSS gradient code; live preview
- PNG (transparency) or JPG export
- Presets from 1080×1080 through 8K (7680×4320)
- Turkish and English UI
- Runs in the browser via HTML5 Canvas
